note: expected_http_error_console_lines are the browser's own log lines for intentionally provoked failures (revision conflicts, a rejected element, refused tokens after simulated and real API restarts, save failure, save conflict, connection resets that drop create responses, a refused token before an unconfirmed create is resent, two failed autosaves, a late autosave reply held until the page moved to a copy, and an edit refused after another client moved the session). edits_while_a_request_is_pending delays transactions by 400 ms. The recovery steps kill the API process with SIGKILL and start a new one. The simulated-restart step's intermittent failure (#8) was a Playwright route-expiry race in the check, now guarded; see browser-route-race.json for the cause, repeated runs, and diagnostics. A failure leaves failure.png, requests.log, api.log, and web.log. Not run in CI.
